translation.question: ศูนย์กีฬาจูไห่ออกประกาศระงับการให้บริการเวลาใด หลังเกิดเหตุการณ์ขับรถพุ่งชนคนในจูไห่ปี 2024
translation.translation_note: Translated '9 p.m.' to the standard Thai 24-hour time format '21:00 น.' which is commonly used in formal and news contexts.

backtranslation_en.question: At what time did the Zhuhai Sports Center issue an announcement suspending services after the 2024 Zhuhai car ramming incident?

consistency.reason: The target language QA accurately translates the source question and the expected answer '21:00 น.' is the standard Thai equivalent of '9 p.m.'.
